entities.name: Mohammed Al Ameen Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Mohammad Al-Ameen Mosque, also referred to as the Bahwan Mosque after its private financiers, is located in Bawshar, in the Muscat Governorate of the Sultanate of Oman. The mosque was completed in 2014.
